ideas.title: The Impact of the Child Care Funding Freeze on Families
ideas.description: Investigate the impact of the child care funding freeze on families who rely on the funding for child care services.
questions: How many families will be impacted by the funding freeze?
What alternatives are available to families who rely on the funding?
ideas.insight: I believe that this story has the potential to highlight the human impact of the funding freeze and to hold the Trump administration accountable for their decision.
